extras.approval_status: DRAFT — measures alignment with each person's own REAL klub (brno:org:group:* rows from ostrava/scripts/party_affiliation.py, sourced from dated per-vote klub groupings — D7's preferred live-group case). Does not depend on which groups form the government, so it does not require the same D7 sign-off as govity/wpca's government_groups — ready to use as-is.
extras.vocabulary_source: Same vocabulary mapping as attendance_definition.json (see that file's extras.vocabulary_source).
extras.note: Rebelity requires each person's group membership at each vote-event date, sourced from data/memberships.csv's ostrava:org:group:* rows via ostrava/scripts/build_all_members.py's 'groups' field.
extras.known_gap: Klub data is only available for the first vote of 24/31 meetings (2022-10-19 through 2025-06-18) — see ostrava/scripts/party_affiliation.py's module docstring and ostrava/scripts/check_klub_staleness.py. No klub grouping has been published by the source since 2025-06-18 (already 400+ days stale as of this writing). Memberships are left open-ended past the last confirmed date (standard 'last verified, presumed ongoing' semantics), so rebelity scores for votes after that date use each person's last-confirmed klub — genuinely current klub composition beyond 2025-06-18 is NOT independently verified and could be stale for any individual member. This is a real, acknowledged limitation, not silently smoothed over.
